text:
dana: Starting Voltix joint benchmark next Tue. Scope: perf/W sweep, throughput, kernel tuning iterations. Need owners for run matrix, telemetry, and canary plan in Voltix lab.

michael: Sounds good. Use NovaEdge matrix as inspiration but slim it: models (redwood-7b, 3b), quants (fp16,int8), batch sizes [1,4,8], seq [512,1024]. Metrics: gpu_power_w, host_power_w, tokens_s, p95_latency_ms, energy_j_per_token.

sara: I'll own telemetry and the CSV schema. Will export per-run CSV + consolidated JSONL. @lee can you confirm Prom labels and an export path?

lee: Plan: prometheus labels model,quant,batch,seq,run_id,lab. Expose metrics: gpu_power_w, board_temp_c, kv_cache_bytes, tokens_generated_total, latency_ms_bucket. Export to s3://redwood-partnerships/voltix/3380012345/. I'll add a PromQL for energy/token.

dana: Kernel tuning plan: baseline -> tuneA -> tuneB -> final. Voltix will provide kernel blobs in their lab only. Legal ok'ed coop NDA but no public kernel drops. Raj, update from Voltix?

raj: Voltix confirmed lab access window: two-week dev window, weekly checkpoints. They request a tech note describing kernel deltas and rollback safety.

michael: Standard run command we can pin in runbook:

```
./run_bench --model redwood-7b --batch 4 --seq 1024 --quant int8 --iters 3 --warmup 10 --out s3://redwood-partnerships/voltix/3380012345/
```

bench-bot: CI smoke: 1/3 runs failed with OOM on run 2 (kv cache spike). Logs at s3://bench/artifacts/voltix/3380012345/logs.tar.gz.

sara: Noted OOM. We'll add `--kv-flush` between iterations and track peak_kv_bytes. I'll add nvprof hooks for GPU mem traces. CSV columns: model,batch,seq,quant,avg_gpu_w,host_w,tokens_s,energy_j_per_token,peak_kv_bytes.

lee: PromQL to compute energy per token (1m rate):

```
sum(rate(gpu_power_w[1m])) / sum(rate(tokens_generated_total[1m]))
```

michael: Marketing: @jen can you draft a short "what this enables" blurb and a partner quote placeholder? We'll fill once canary numbers are final.

jen: Sure — I'll prep a one-paragraph draft and a separate marketplace claim checklist (must have lab signoff + SI rack-power verification).

dana: Action items: sara telemetry schema (EOD), lee prometheus exporter changes (tomorrow AM), michael PR with matrix/runbook (today), raj coordinate Voltix schedule (today). Weekly sync set for Friday -> will decide canary timing.

bench-bot: Created GH issue #5299 "Voltix perf: matrix + telemetry + canary" and linked artifacts. Calendar invite for weekly sync created.

michael: I'll open the PR and tag reviewers. Thanks everyone — prioritize the OOM mitigation so voltix lab can run canary by end of window.

dana: End state: signed-off canary in partner lab, telemetry artifacts in S3, marketing draft ready pending numbers.

bench-bot: Reminder: weekly Voltix sync Friday 3380015945 (calendar invite sent).
